Itna high aim karo jitna tum sochte ho usse bhi.
"Patience hope ki art hai."
Self-belief success ka pehla secret hai.
"Tum wahi bante, jo sochte rehte."
Perseverance sab jeet leti hai.
Able ho ya soch rahe ho, tum right ho.
Tumhare saath kya hota hai itna nahi—matter karta.
Mind enlightened ho jaye—phir unenlightened nahi hota.
Attitude, aptitude nahi—altitude decide karega.
Doosron ki rai mein apni awaaz mat kho.
Goals pe stubborn, methods pe flexible.
